name: ERICSSON LM TELEPHONE CO

ads_ratio.source: Ericsson Form 20-F for FY2025 (filed 2026-03-12), cover page: 'American Depositary Shares (each representing one B share)'; the FY2025 annual report states the same: 'Each ADS represents one Class B share.'
ads_ratio.reason: EDGAR share counts are ordinary (A+B) shares and the Nasdaq price is per ADS; at a 1:1 ratio per-share figures are directly comparable to the ADS price with no scaling.

fx_conversion.source: frankfurter.app — ECB reference rates (closest business day to each period end)

overrides_applied.source: Ericsson Form 20-F for FY2025 (filed 2026-03-12), Financial Report Note G3 'Share-based compensation', table 'Compensation expense for LTV 2022-2025': total compensation expense SEK 1,206M (2023), SEK 2,080M (2024), SEK 1,790M (2025). The engine's ifrs-full tag ExpenseFromSharebasedPaymentTransactionsWithEmployees is filed only through FY2019 (SEK 256M), so EDGAR companyfacts carries no SBC for 2020-2025.
overrides_applied.reason: The engine accepts a single override value applied to every unfilled period; SEK 1,790M is both the filed FY2025 expense and the median of the three filed gap-year figures (1,206 / 2,080 / 1,790), so the median-of-3-FY base is built from filed figures with offsetting errors of ~1% of OE in the non-median years. It is ~7.0x the last engine-filed value (FY2019 SEK 256M) — inside the 0.1x-10x band — and the step-up is real: the Key Contributor cash-settled plans scaled up from 2022 (Note G3). ~90% of the expense is cash-settled plans (a real cash cost through provisions); only SEK 175M of FY2025's total is share-settled.

fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

FX_CONVERTED: reporting currency SEK converted to USD at period-end ECB reference rates (frankfurter.app) — flow facts use the period-end rate, not a period average; the rates used are recorded in dcf_numbers.json fx_conversion

ADS_RATIO_APPLIED: 20-F filer — per-share figures scaled x1.0 ordinary shares per ADS (Ericsson Form 20-F for FY2025 (filed 2026-03-12), cover page: 'American Depositary Shares (each representing one B share)'; the FY2025 annual report states the same: 'Each ADS represents one Class B share.') so they are comparable to the ADS price; TTM pins are taken as per-ADS already

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:sbc — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (filing: Ericsson Form 20-F for FY2025 (filed 2026-03-12), Financial Report Note G3 'Share-based compensation', table 'Compensation expense for LTV 2022-2025': total compensation expense SEK 1,206M (2023), SEK 2,080M (2024), SEK 1,790M (2025). The engine's ifrs-full tag ExpenseFromSharebasedPaymentTransactionsWithEmployees is filed only through FY2019 (SEK 256M), so EDGAR companyfacts carries no SBC for 2020-2025.); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact

override_impact.basis: engine-native normalized base (median of last 3 FY) and weighted IRR, DCF run both ways (zero-fill baseline vs with-override); a --base-oe-ps TTM base is excluded from both sides — its override effect shows in ttm.py output
